segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine selection
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu
The ‘heart’ of Enlil, it is the river Tigris, did it not bring sweet water?

segments.text_en: Divine command and initial nocturnal vision
evidence: I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth
The brick of deciding destinies lifted the head towards him
It was then, in a ‘dark goat’, that towards his king, on the lord Ningirsu, Gudea looked
“Build his house!,” he ordered him

segments.text_en: Epistemic uncertainty and deliberation to consult Nanše
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant, counseled about the message
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me

segments.text_en: Voyage to Bagara and supplication to Ningirsu
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water, he went to the king of Bagara, and prayed to him
Ningirsu, let me build your house for you, let me make the ‘me’ perfect for you
From Gudea, his offering and his prayer, his king, the lord Ningirsu, received from him

segments.text_en: Intercession and maternal blessing of Gatumdu
evidence: I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother. I am a no-father-haver, you are my father
To Nina, mountain raising out of the sea, may your good Utukku go in front of me, may your good Lamma follow me on my path
Let me bring my dream to my mother, my dream-interpreter knowing ‘ku3’ by herself
His lady, the offering and the prayer, Shiny-Gatumdu received from Gudea

segments.text_en: Arrival at Siraran and recitation of the enigmatic dream
evidence: Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven, his greatness was like the earth
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand. She had the tablet of the stars on her lap
he bent the arm, he held a lapis writing board in the hand, he drew the plan of the house
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me

segments.text_en: Dream decipherment and ritual instruction by Nanše
evidence: My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you
The man (who was) great like the heaven... it is surely my brother Ningirsu
That is surely Nisaba, my sister... It is Nindubba, placing the house on the plan of the house
after you entered for him into Eninnu, ‘the white Anzu bird’, with it, he will receive your small word, as if it was a mighty word
He will reveal the plan of his house to you

segments.text_en: Crafting gifts and ceremonial presentation to Ningirsu
evidence: He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood
He made it straight for him, for the lapis chariot
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, he wrote his name on it
Joyfully he entered to him in the house

segments.text_en: Purification vigil and petition for a confirmatory sign
evidence: He flattened the hills, he returned accusations. He removed the spittle from the dagger
Juniper, the pure tree of the mountain he placed on the fire, cedar incense, the incense of the gods
Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, ‘heart’... I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Direct divine epiphany and promises of cosmic abundance
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house
With the founding of my house, may abundance arrive
At midnight the moon goes up for you, at midday the abundance of the sun goes up for you
In the land of stone, large boulders of stone from the mountains, I will cut into blocks for you
On that day (when) your arm is touched with fire, I will teach you my sign

segments.text_en: Awakening, extispicy confirmation, and civic moral purification
evidence: Gudea rose, it was a dream. He is afraid, it was a dream
He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good
area-Lagash makes its ‘heart’ like one for him, like one mothers sons
A mother does not accuse a son, accusations, a son to his mother does not speak
The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire

segments.text_en: Platform purification and consecration of the brick mold
evidence: He laid down the goat by the box, the mold, he made the brick appear by the goat
(For the) platform, he cleanses 24 ‘iku’ of the city for him, he purifies the platform for him
Juniper, the pure plant of the mountain, he placed on the fire, The cedar incense, the scent of the gods, its smoke he made
The Anunna of area-Lagash, in order to build the house of Ningirsu... they stood with him

segments.text_en: Mobilization of territorial levies and foreign tribute
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land, in the totality of all of his lands
In the Gu'edina of Ningirsu he placed a levy
Elam came to him from Elam. Susa came to him from Susa
Magan and Meluhha, from their land, submitted to him. For the construction of Ningirsu’s house, they assembled for Gudea in his city Girsu

segments.text_en: Expeditions for timber, stone, and precious metallurgy
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu made way for him
He cut down its cedars with the great axe
To the land of stone, where no man enters, Gudea for the Lord Ningirsu made way for him
From Kimaš, the mountain of copper... the copper he excavated there
Purified silver is being brought down for Gudea from its mountain

segments.text_en: Sleepless devotion, divine architectural wisdom, and ground survey
evidence: Concerning the building of his king’s house, he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him. Enki made the plan of the house right for him
the field was right, he measured it, he placed sticks on its border, he knew himself
It is morning, he went in prayer to the old house. Gudea, at Baragirnunata calmed his ‘heart’

segments.text_en: Ritual fabrication and blessing of the primordial brick
evidence: The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies, he raised to Eninnu
He greased it with honey, butter oil, and fine butter oil
Gudea placed clay in the mold. The cultic order emerged
He placed the brick, he brought the mold into the house, he lifted the brick from the mold, it is a shiny throne raised to heaven

segments.text_en: Continued vigil, omen validation, and cosmic separation vision
evidence: Like a young man building a new house, he does not allow sweet sleep to enter his eyes
he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good. He gave grain to the wave, its appearance was straight
Gudea lying by the top, he slept, the word dawned on him
the separation of Eninnu from heaven and earth, was brought to his attention

segments.text_en: Foundation laying and the sevenfold cosmic blessing
evidence: Enki places the foundation of the house, Nanše, the daughter of Eridu cared for the omen taking
he placed the foundation, the wall touched the ground, he gave a blessing, he stroked the brick with flax
For the fourth (time) did he not give a blessing in the house? It is a young lion embracing a terrible lion
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house? It is Eninnu—Moon passing (through)—filling the land

segments.text_en: Superstructure erection, subterranean anchoring, and basin dedication
evidence: They make the house grow like a mountain. They make it float in the middle of the heaven like a cloud
he placed the very large mast, the foundation, its Abzu, in the ground. With Enki, in E'angurraka, he counseled with him there
His large stones brought in their blocks, he brought them in a single year, he worked them in a single year
A stone on its side he laid down as a basin, he formed it with incense, he placed them in the house

segments.text_en: Dedication and naming of the monumental stelas
evidence: His stone erected in the mighty courtyard, ‘the stela, king filling the courtyard, Lord Ningirsu made Gudea known from Girnun,’ as name of that stone he named
His stone erected in front of the rising sun, ‘the King, roaring storm of Enlil, lord no-haver of rival, Lord Ningirsu, Gudea, in his shiny ‘heart’ called him,’ as name of that stone he named
His stone erected in Baba’s back-room, ‘Eninnu, knowing the face of An, Baba, life of Gudea,’ as name of that stone he named

segments.text_en: Architectural completion, cosmic brilliance, and divine harmony
evidence: The righteous shepherd Gudea made it grow together with heaven and earth
Gudea made Ningirsu’s house go out from the cloud like Utu, made it grow like a mountain of Lapis
The house, his white flood returning, it is a lapis mountain firmly moored in heaven and earth
He built, and after he had finished it, it is the ‘heart’ of the gods, returned to its banks

segments.text_en: Installation of mythical warrior trophies and apotropaic warding
evidence: At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there
Because they are dead warriors, he placed their mouths at the libation place, (and) their names, in the midst of the gods... made them emerge
Eninnu, its lock, a bison(?), its pivots, a lion; from its bolt, Muššatur (and) Mušhuš stretch out the tongue against an aurochs
The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands, like a garment, it covered

segments.text_en: Temple outfitting, functional storehouses, and sanctuary abundance
evidence: The face of the house is a large mountain leaning on earth, its inside is a polyphonic song
From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries, From the mighty oven, large cakes, large croissants(!?)
In the treasury, precious stones, silver, tin
The big fear of the house rests on the land. Its praise reaches the mountains

segments.text_en: Final cosmic elevation and concluding hymnic doxology
evidence: The house (was) built in joy by its king. Ningešzida built it on a big place
Gudea, governor of Lagash, placed its foundation
like a green mountain clad in joy, --standing to be admired
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised! The building of the house of Ningirsu, this is the middle of the praise
